Sales is the final amount after discount, in ₹ (Cr = crore, L = lakh). Profit is final amount minus cost. Retention rate is the share of orders placed by returning and loyal customers. Customers are unique customer IDs. Source: Decathlon_Synthetic_Data_30000.xlsx, 30,000 synthetic orders. Data notes: order dates run to 31 Dec 2026, 4,453 orders carry a unit price of exactly ₹100 (looks like a placeholder), and monthly orders fall from about 900 to about 570 from July 2026. All are included as supplied.
